<b>Steel Seer Zi</b> is an [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPC]] who appears in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, exclusively in [[Steel Soul Mode (Silksong)|Steel Soul Mode]]. A steel child of the [[Steel Society]], she is located at the far eastern edge of the [[Blasted Steps]] and gives the <i>[[A Vassal Lost]]</i> [[wish]].

== Background ==
Zi resides in a small hidden area in the [[Blasted Steps]] and has unseen Masters to whom she is obedient.<ref>Steel Seer Zi: <i>"Masters... Yes... For them, Zi observes... obedient... always..."</i></ref> She shares her Masters with [[Sula]], [[Steel Soul Jinn]] and [[Confessor Jiji]]. Her vassal, Sula, betrayed their superior and Masters and fled, and Zi requires them to be found, either dead or alive, to avoid her Masters' wrath.<ref>Steel Seer Zi: <i>"Seek the vassal... Retrieve them, or their corpse... either is appropriate... either will aid... to avoid the Masters' wrath."</i></ref>

== In-game Events ==
Zi can be found dormant and can be awoken by being struck with the [[Needle]]. Zi asks [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] to find her lost vassal by offering the <i>[[A Vassal Lost]]</i> wish. Upon completing the wish, she gifts Hornet [[Growstone]].

== Location ==
Steel Seer Zi can be found at the far eastern edge of the [[Blasted Steps]]. A breakable wall hides a cave normally inhabited by a [[Silkeater]], but in [[Steel Soul Mode (Silksong)|Steel Soul Mode]], it instead contains a tunnel leading to Zi.

== Trivia == 
* Zi appears on the icon of the <i>Steel Soul</i> and <i>Steel Heart</i> [[Achievements (Silksong)#Challenges|achievements]].
* While not accessible in-game, Zi's cavern is present in <abbr title="The default game mode.">Classic Mode</abbr>, but it resembles the rest of the Blasted Steps more than in Steel Soul Mode.
{{Gallery
| Image1 = Screenshot SS Steel Seer Zi 04.png ! Zi's cavern in Classic Mode
}}
* Zi is surrounded by a large rune which continuously pulsates inwards towards her. The rune's sprite is named <code>sentinel_rune</code> in the game files.
** Its design somewhat resembles the [[Farsight]] rune, suggesting that Zi may be using a similar power to track down her vassal and sense events occurring in the world.<ref>Steel Seer Zi: <i>"Zi has sensed their movement... She knows their places of rest. For pale It... Zi shall mark their chart."</i></ref><ref>Steel Seer Zi: <i>"The wish? No... pale It... Zi sensed clear your meeting... The rite... The vassal is tarnished."</i></ref>
** Internally, Steel Seer Zi's rune is called both "sonar" and "worldsense", supporting its similarity to Farsight.
{{Gallery
| Image1 = Steer Seer Zi Farsight.png ! Comparison
}}
